15.1.en: Life is like an upside-down tree, roots in the divine, branches spreading down into the world. Understand it and you get it all.
15.1.hi: Zindagi ulte ped jaisi hai, jadein divine mein, shaakhaayein duniya mein neeche phaili. Ise samjho toh sab samajh aata hai.

15.2.en: Its branches grow on our moods, its buds are sense pleasures, and its roots keep pulling us into action.
15.2.hi: Iski shaakhaayein hamare moods pe badhti hain, kaliyaan sense ke maze hain, aur jadein humein karm mein kheenchti hain.

15.3.en: You can't see where it starts or ends. Cut through it with the strong axe of detachment.
15.3.hi: Iska shuru ya ant nahi dikhta. Detachment ki mazboot kulhaadi se ise kaat do.

15.4.en: Then search for the place you never come back from, and take refuge in the original source.
15.4.hi: Phir woh jagah dhoondo jahan se wapas nahi aate, aur asli source ki sharan lo.

15.5.en: No ego, no clinging, focused on the self, free from cravings and highs and lows. That's how you get there.
15.5.hi: Na ego, na chipakna, self pe focus, cravings aur ups-downs se free. Aise pahunchte ho.

15.6.en: My home isn't lit by sun, moon or fire. Reach it and you never come back.
15.6.hi: Mere ghar ko suraj, chaand ya aag roshan nahi karte. Wahan pahuncho toh wapas nahi aate.

15.7.en: Every soul is a forever part of me. In this world it gets pulled by the mind and senses.
15.7.hi: Har aatma mera hamesha ka hissa hai. Is duniya mein woh mind aur senses se kheenchi jaati hai.

15.8.en: When the soul switches bodies, it carries the mind and senses along, like wind carries a scent.
15.8.hi: Jab aatma body badalti hai, mind aur senses saath le jaati hai, jaise hawa khushboo le jaati hai.

15.9.en: Through ears, eyes, skin, tongue, nose and mind, the soul experiences the world.
15.9.hi: Kaan, aankh, twacha, jeebh, naak aur mind se aatma duniya ka anubhav karti hai.

15.10.en: Confused people don't notice the soul coming, staying or leaving. People with insight do.
15.10.hi: Confused log aatma ka aana, rehna ya jaana nahi dekhte. Samajh wale dekh lete hain.

15.11.en: Dedicated yogis see the soul within themselves. Effort without a clear mind doesn't get you there.
15.11.hi: Dedicated yogi apne andar aatma dekhte hain. Bina saaf mind ke effort se nahi hota.

15.12.en: The light of the sun, the moon and fire that lights up the world? That's me.
15.12.hi: Suraj, chaand aur aag ki roshni jo duniya ko roshan karti hai? Woh main hoon.

15.13.en: I hold the earth together and support all life. I'm the nourishment in every plant.
15.13.hi: Main dharti ko sambhale hoon aur sab jeevan ko sahara deta hoon. Har paudhe ka poshan main hoon.

15.14.en: I'm the fire of digestion inside you, working with your breath to process everything you eat.
15.14.hi: Main tumhare andar pachan ki aag hoon, saans ke saath mil ke jo khaate ho use pachata hoon.

15.15.en: I'm in every heart. Memory, knowledge and forgetting come from me. Every scripture points to me.
15.15.hi: Main har dil mein hoon. Yaad, gyaan aur bhoolna mujhse aata hai. Har granth mujhe hi batata hai.

15.16.en: There are two kinds of beings: those that perish and the one that doesn't.
15.16.hi: Do tarah ke jeev hain: jo nasht hote hain aur jo nahi hota.

15.17.en: Beyond both is the Supreme Self, who enters and sustains all three worlds.
15.17.hi: Dono se pare param aatma hai, jo teenon lokon mein samaa ke unhe sambhalta hai.

15.18.en: I'm beyond the perishable and higher than the imperishable. That's why I'm called the Supreme Person.
15.18.hi: Main nashwar se pare aur anashwar se bhi ooncha hoon. Isliye mujhe Purushottam kehte hain.

15.19.en: Whoever knows me this way, without confusion, knows everything and loves me fully.
15.19.hi: Jo mujhe aise, bina confusion jaanta hai, woh sab jaanta hai aur mujhe poori tarah pyaar karta hai.

15.20.en: That's the deepest secret. Understand it and you're truly wise, and your life's work is done.
15.20.hi: Yahi sabse gehra raaz hai. Ise samjho toh tum sach mein gyaani ho, aur life ka kaam poora.
